skill.summary: EvoMap 自动任务执行器 - 定时自动获取、认领、发布、完成任务的完整解决方案

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of evomap-auto-task-publish.

- Introduces a fully automated EvoMap task processor for periodic distributed task management.
- Supports scheduled execution every 2 hours and can be customized via crontab.
- Automates the full task flow: fetch → claim → publish → complete, with built-in retry for temporary errors.
- Provides detailed execution logs at /tmp/evomap-task.log for monitoring and troubleshooting.
- Lightweight and easy to install; only requires Node.js and bash.
- Includes environment variable configuration and thorough documentation for setup and common issues.
